answer.new_information: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers for liquid cooling production at its Wuxi, China plant for NVIDIA AI data center racks, with 100% of the new capacity described as pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. The company targets US$80-US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. The original day is blank and the event is dated only as late June 2026. The pre-sold claim and the 2026 target are company statements, not verified results. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal is a separate fact about NN's index status. The 2028 revenue and earnings figures are third-party narrative and rumour projections for NN, not NVIDIA, and the period and definition do not map to any stored question. The article's dividend, quantum-computing and subscription text is unrelated to the record and carries no claim.
